info.title: SDKWork Partner Backend API
info.description: Backend administration API for the multi-level partner (agent) management system: levels and commission ratios, partners, join fees, customer bindings, commission events and settlements, ledger, withdrawals, and stats.

get.summary: List join fee payments of a partner

post.summary: Record a join fee payment and trigger ancestor commission

get.summary: List customer bindings of a partner

post.summary: Bind a customer to a partner

delete.summary: Unbind a customer from a partner

post.summary: Create a manual commission revenue event
Run commission settlement for pending events

get.summary: List ledger entries of a partner

patch.summary: Approve or reject a withdrawal request
Mark an approved withdrawal as paid

joinFee.description: Join fee amount for this level.

maxCommissionDepth.description: Max ancestor depth for commission (0 = unlimited).

ownerId.description: Operator id that created the partner.

paidBy.description: Operator id that recorded the payment.

boundBy.description: Operator id that bound the customer.

unboundBy.description: Operator id that unbound the customer.

skipped.description: Events skipped (no active binding or no allocation).

limit.description: Max events to process in this run (default 100).
